description: Groups multiple security profiles into a single object referenced by Security Policy rules (Provider v2.0.x).

name.description: Name of the security profile group.

scope_type.description: Scope for this object. Note: vsys is not supported for this resource in v2.0.x.

spyware.description: Anti-Spyware profiles (includes DNS Security logic). Comma-separated if multiple.

vulnerability.description: Vulnerability protection profiles. Comma-separated if multiple.

url_filtering.description: URL Filtering profiles. Comma-separated if multiple.

file_blocking.description: File Blocking profiles. Comma-separated if multiple.

wildfire_analysis.description: WildFire Analysis profiles. Comma-separated if multiple.

data_filtering.description: Data Filtering profiles. Comma-separated if multiple.
